deployStep: Vercel builds only commits whose message carries the deploy marker (vercel.json ignoreCommand), so the deployed SHA will be an empty marker commit on top of sourceCommit, as for r23 and r24. Steps: git commit-tree $(git rev-parse <tip of release/r25>^{tree}) -p <tip of release/r25> with a marker r25 message; push it to release/r25; then Vercel create_deployment, target production, gitSource github hanialshater/system-3-company ref release/r25 at that SHA. Check that the build log names that SHA and 'Next.js 16.4.3'.
